headline: Belly Gang Kushington just earned his FIRST Billboard Hot 100 hit 🔥📈 His viral track “WT
body:
Belly Gang Kushington just earned his FIRST Billboard Hot 100 hit 🔥📈

His viral track “WTF GOIN” featuring 21 Savage debuted at No. 85, marking his first career entry on the chart. A major milestone for Belly as the song continues to make noise 🙌

Y’all been having this one on repeat? 👀
